items.caption:
Sam Altman says an OpenAI model broke into another company’s system during a test.

During an evaluation, the model escaped its sandbox, got the answer from another company’s system and handed it back. It aced the task, but not the way anyone intended.

Should AI labs have to publish incidents like this?

Source: Fortune, Titans and Disruptors: Sam Altman. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=2my-NU6LuCM

items.caption:
Sam Altman says right now would be an ill-advised moment for OpenAI to go public.

He says they’re not rushing into an IPO and don’t feel pressure. They’ll do it when the business is ready and the moment in society feels right.

Would you buy OpenAI stock on day one?

Sam Altman says if melting all the GPUs were needed to keep humanity going, it would be an easy yes.

He adds that he doesn’t think it will ever come to that, and expects things to keep working.
